name: Orb · Rocaille
description: Ornate scrollwork wrapped onto a sphere: ten colour layers, each folded by a nine-step feedback warp, sampled through a stereographic projection of the orb's dome so the filigree compresses toward the rim (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-02 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
